purpose: Machine-readable mapping from every FBL-020-R7 clause — as amended by FBL-020-R7-A1 — to the implementation, the named tests, the mutations and the deterministic gates that prove it. scripts/check-requirement-map.ts verifies that both authority digests match the checked-in order texts, that every requirement id is well formed and unique, that every named implementation file and test file exists, that every named test EXISTS VERBATIM in the named file, that every named runtime-mutation id exists in scripts/mutation-kill.ts and every named database-control id exists in scripts/database-control-mutations.ts, and that EVERY clause in clause_inventory is covered by at least one requirement — so an omitted requirement is a failure rather than a silent gap. FBL-020-R7-A1 §6 governs the vocabulary: exact test names and mutation identifiers are recorded here because they are what the gates kill against, not because the order mandated the spellings.

authority.precedence: The amendment is part of R7 and controls wherever the two conflict (its own first sentence). The security outcomes of R7 §2–§5 and A1 §9 are unchanged by it; what it relaxes is implementation method, Git workflow, commit count, file scope, test naming and packaging shape.
authority.verdict_vocabulary: PROVEN = the named tests, mutations and gates exercise the clause's own property and are green locally against a real PostgreSQL 16. PENDING-CI = additionally awaiting the exact-SHA ci.yml run at the final R7 head, which FBL-020-R7-A1 §7 binds to the commits via the external return packet rather than via any checked-in run id. EXTERNAL = dischargeable only outside this repository. No verdict here is a claim of architect acceptance; FBL-020-R7-A1 §10 makes acceptance the release gate.

clause_inventory.text: Governing disposition: R6 retained-not-accepted; baseline ee5eb6b00ef91542f3129fa9957fc22d3ce51f0f (tree 6bc4302612abfc97df0854708ee576ba3108a616, run 32493409959 green 4/4); FBL-030 blocked; live WorkOS certification undischarged; migrations 000, 049–058 frozen; every schema correction in NEW migrations/059; no new census; both external project copies remain Version 1.0; the repository Version 2.0 blueprint is correctly committed.

Delivery discipline — as amended by FBL-020-R7-A1 §§1, 4, 5 and 7: order and amendment checked in verbatim; branch from the exact baseline; normal disclosed commits and pushes replace the one-commit/squash rule; iterate on red CI instead of stopping; never claim a run that does not exist; preserve the working R6 controls.
Login completion is judged against ONE fresh clock_timestamp() instant used for both the expiry predicate and consumed_at; refusal classification reads the live clock; JS time never decides.

A missing, non-string or wrong presented purpose is callback_purpose_mismatch and ends the transaction it names, on the login and step-up legs alike; the routes forward the handle and never pre-screen the defect.

Step-up refusals carry exact terminal reasons: callback_state_mismatch, callback_pkce_mismatch and callback_redirect_mismatch are distinct, each with one failed terminal row and one identity.reauthentication.failed event.

The support tuple: requester and session actor are REAL platform-scope links; the session actor IS the approved requester of its own request, referentially; actor-type labels are bound to the actor's real scope.

Request and session authority fields are immutable; granted_at ≥ decided_at; expiry ≤ requested duration; the approving grant names this exact request with action identity.support.approve, resource type support_access_request, fresh_and_mfa_policy assurance and certified MFA; an approved non-tenant scope exists in-tenant on an effective chain.

The platform.* action-name bypass is removed: delegation is required structurally; a control-plane decision is platform-scoped with NO authorization tenant and NO customer resource; the operational target tenant is metadata in its own column.

ONE database-authoritative resource-scope registry shared by runtime and validators; the validated leaf is persisted; organization bindings are validated against the resource's real ancestry; caller-supplied scope columns are validated, never trusted.
ONE database authority for effective ancestry used by runtime AND validators; tenant, leaf and every ancestor validated as active and in-window at write time.

Liveness is judged at the actual write instant (clock_timestamp()), never transaction-start NOW() and never occurred_at; occurred_at is consistency-checked only; a straddling transaction is refused; an expired session with a backdated occurred_at is refused.

The forgeable GUC is removed as authorization; migration-owner and runtime roles are separated; the API and worker run as a non-owner runtime role with no child-table DML; normalization is SECURITY DEFINER, owned by an unassumable role, with a fixed search_path; parent/child equivalence is preserved.

Migration rules: 059 only; 000 and 049–058 byte-immutable; evidence version 4 with versions 1–3 preserved unrewritten; an exact-checksum pre-059 chain; the populated drill builds and uses a real 058 database, generates post-058 activity through production paths, applies 059, verifies every new invariant, proves the bounded precheck refusals on injected invalid rows, and converges fresh and upgraded fingerprints; every refusal is actionable and truthful and never instructs editing append-only evidence.

Tests, mutations and gates: at least 654 tests / 64 suites preserved and raised to the delivered battery with zero failed/cancelled/skipped/todo; ratchet at or below 53/123/1; the seven named runtime mutations killed; one database mutation per atomic predicate with zero survivors; the full gate set green.

Documentation: order (and amendment) checked in verbatim; this requirement map; ONE canonical state record saying SUBMITTED FOR REVIEW — NOT ACCEPTED that never claims the final run exists inside the commit that triggers it; other documents reference rather than restate; external blockers preserved unexpanded.

Return packet — as amended by FBL-020-R7-A1 §8: an independently verifiable external package binding repository identity, final commit and tree, exact source bytes from the Git object, the exact-SHA run with every job conclusion, CI artifacts and hashes, test and mutation results, migration-chain integrity, package checksum and the remaining external blockers; then stop for architect acceptance.
Non-negotiable outcomes: the amendment's own register of what implementation freedom does not relax — each item is covered by the R7-§2/§3/§4/§5 rows above and the blockers row below.
